node.title: Re^3: Using Tie::IxHash to keep database query keys/values in order
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [bradcathey],

I'm building a CSV file

If you use selectall_arrayref, that'll pull all the results from the database into memory. I imagine that fetching the results row by row with [mod://DBI]'s fetchrow_arrayref, the return value of which can be fed directly into [mod://Text::CSV]'s print method, would be more efficient.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
